title: Finite scalar target comparison on a good complex
statement: For any f:X→Y, n≥0 and good completed integral complex P on Y, finite pullback of the derived scalar presentation at Y, followed by the derived finite geometric presentation, finite pullback of the scalar computation map and the intrinsic geometric computation factor, equals finite pullback of the pbc scalar counit followed by the geometric computation factor on the pbc scalar complex, Q of pullback of the degreewise ordinary scalar presentation, and Q of the degreewise finite geometric presentation. No condition on the pullback of P, no realization model and no coefficient sequence are involved.

source.place: Finite scalar target comparison on a good complex in the finite scalar cochain calculation; Stacks Tags 07A6, 06YY and 0D6E.

proof.text: Apply naturality of the derived finite geometric presentation to the finite scalar computation map. Its localization-factor equation identifies the resulting comparison at Q(CY) with Q of the ordinary geometric presentation.

The finite scalar counit normalization replaces the scalar presentation followed by the finite scalar computation map with the pbc scalar counit followed by Q of the ordinary scalar presentation. Apply the finite geometric pullback functor to this equation.
Naturality of the exact geometric localization factor moves the ordinary scalar presentation across it. Paste the three equations.

theorem finiteScalarPullReductionComparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory) :
    let := sfIntrinsicPullback_additive (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f
    let := sfIntrinsicPullback_preservesFiniteLimits (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f
    let := sfIntrinsicPullback_preservesFiniteColimits (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f
    let := scalarReductionExtensionAdditive.{u, u} l E Y n
    let a := PurCompactSupport.reduction l E (n + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)
    let S := PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)
    let T := proEtaleRingModulePullback f (S.ring Y) (S.ring X) (S.pull f)
    let TD := PurCompactSupport.pull S f
    let I := sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f
    let CY := ((scalarReductionExtension l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P.obj
    let BY := ((pbcExtend (a.map Y)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P.obj
    let αYc := (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex
      (finiteScalarOrdinaryReductionIso l E Y n).hom (.up ℤ)).app P.obj
    let lam := PurCompactSupport.finitePullbackIso l E n f
    TD.map ((PurCompactSupport.finiteReductionIso l E Y n).hom.app
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj)) ≫
      (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso lam).hom.app
        ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E Y n).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj)) ≫
      (finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).map
        (coefficientFiniteReductionModel l E Y P.obj P.property.1 n).hom ≫
      I.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app CY =
    TD.map (pbcComplexCounit (a.map Y) P.obj) ≫
      T.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app BY ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map ((T.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map αYc) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex lam (.up ℤ)).hom.app CY)
